items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Public Administration, or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Master’s degree in a related field
Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible Academic Personnel or Human Resources experience
Experience interpreting complex personnel policies and advising leadership on personnel matters
Experience supervising staff and managing operational functions
Experience in an academic health center or medical school environment

The UCLA Department of Psychiatry & Biobehavioral Sciences is one of the nation’s premier academic psychiatry departments, supporting excellence in patient care, research, education, and community engagement. We are seeking an experienced Academic HR Manager to lead the departments’ Academic Personnel function and provide strategic guidance on faculty affairs across a large and complex academic environment. Key responsibilities include:
Lead and oversee all academic personnel operations, including faculty recruitment, appointments, promotions, merits, leaves, and academic reviews
Supervise and develop Academic Personnel staff while ensuring efficient, high-quality service delivery
Serve as the department’s primary advisor on Academic Personel policies and faculty affairs
Provide consultation to department leadership, faculty, and administrators on complex personnel matters
Ensure compliance with University of California and David Geffen School of Medicine policies and procedures
Partner with Finance, Research Administrators, Payroll, and central administrative offices to support departmental goals and initiatives
Drive process improvements and operational excellence within Academic Personnel operations
Advanced proficiency with UCPath, OPUS, AP recruit, MS Office, and other enterprise systems
Expert knowledge of University of California Academic Personnel policies (APM)
Knowledge of Health Sciences Compensation Plan
Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
Demonstrated ability to build collaborative partnerships and lead process improvements
